prompt: In ShiningPie I want a patrol route concept: an entity that marks a path enemies walk, carrying a speed multiplier and a mode that's either Loop or PingPong. Write the component declaration and show me how SceneBinding would read it back into gameplay.
assertions: Declares the record with a [Guid(...)] attribute carrying a real GUID
Does NOT introduce a constants class or a name-string id like "shiningpie.patrol"
Mode is a C# enum rather than a free string
Properties use plain get/set, not init
Read-back uses AuthoredComponentRouter.Materialize plus pattern matching, not a name lookup
Mentions generating the GUID with uuidgen or equivalent rather than inventing one by hand
